G4000.def: from «3999» and «5507»; five times a thousand:--five thousand.

G4003.def: from «4002» and «2532» and «1182»; five and tenth:--fifteenth.

G4005.def: feminine of the ordinal of «4004»; fiftieth (2250 being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost":--Pentecost.

G4006.et: from the perfect of the alternate of (3982)
G4006.def: from the perfect of the alternate of «3958»; reliance:--confidence, trust.

G4007.pos: 1. however much, very much, altogether, indeed
G4007.def: from the base of «4008»; an enclitic particle significant of abundance (thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever:--(whom-)soever.

G4008.et: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of peiro (to "pierce")
G4008.def: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of peiro (to "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:--beyond, farther (other) side, over.

G4009.def: from the same as «4008»; an extremity:--end, ut-(ter-)most participle

G4010.def: from «4444»; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:--Pergamos.

G4011.def: probably from the same as «4010»; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor:--Perga.

G4012.def: from the base of «4008»; properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period):--(there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, × and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, × how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, × (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with. In comparative, it retains substantially the same meaning of circuit (around), excess (beyond), or completeness (through).

G4013.def: from «4012» and «71»; to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around:--compass, go (round) about, lead about.

G4014.def: from «4012» and «138» (including its alternate); to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate:--take away (up).

G4015.def: from «4012» and «797»; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:--shine round (about).

G4016.def: from «4012» and «906»; to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing):--array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

G4017.def: from «4012» and «991»; to look all around:--look (round) about (on).

G4018.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «4016»; something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil:--covering, vesture.

G4019.def: «4012» and «1210»; to bind around one, i.e. enwrap:--bind about.

G4020.def: from «4012» and «2038»; to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle):--be a busybody.

G4021.def: from «4012» and «2041»; working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic):--busybody, curious arts.

G4022.def: from «4012» and «2064» (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e. stroll, vacillate, veer:--fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

G4023.def: from «4012» and «2192»; to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively):--+ astonished, contain, after (this manner).

G4024.def: from «4012» and «2224»; to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively):--gird (about, self).

G4025.def: from «4060»; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with:--wearing.

G4026.def: from «4012» and «2476»; to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from:--avoid, shun, stand by (round about).

G4027.def: from a compound of «4012» and «2508»; something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively):--filth.

G4028.def: from «4012» and «2572»; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.

G4029.def: from «4012» and «2749»; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively):--be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

G4030.def: feminine of a compound of «4012» and «2776»; encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet:--helmet.

G4031.def: from «4012» and «2904»; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+ come by.

G4032.def: from «4012» and «2928»; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:--hide.

G4033.def: from «4012» and «2944»; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely:--compass round.

G4034.def: from «4012» and «2989»; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo:--shine round about.

G4035.def: from «4012» and «3007»; to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive:--remain.

G4036.def: from «4012» and «3077»; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).

G4037.def: from «4012» and «3306»; to stay around, i.e. await:--wait for.

G4038.def: adverb from «4012»; all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent:--round about.

G4039.def: from «4012» and «3611»; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round about.

G4040.def: from «4012» and «3624»; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun):--neighbour.

G4041.et: from the present participle feminine of a compound of (4012) and (1510)
G4041.def: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and «1510»; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.

G4042.def: from «4023»; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.

G4043.def: from «4012» and «3961»; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):--go, be occupied with, walk (about).

G4044.def: from «4012» and the base of «4008»; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix (figuratively):--pierce through.

G4045.def: from «4012» and «4098»; to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with:--fall among (into).

G4046.def: middle voice from «4012» and «4160»; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy):--purchase.

G4047.def: from «4046»; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation:--obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

G4048.def: from «4012» and «4486»; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend off.

G4049.def: from «4012» and «4685»; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care):--cumber.

G4051.def: from «4052»; a surplus, or superabundance:--abundance, that was left, over and above.

G4052.def: from «4053»; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel:--(make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

G4053.def: from «4012» (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with «1537») violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:--exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

G4054.pos:
1. exceeding some number or measure or rank or need
    1. over and above, more than is necessary, superadded
      1. exceeding abundantly, supremely
      2. something further, more, much more than all, more plainly
    2. superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon
      1. pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
G4054.def: neuter of «4055» (as adverb); in a more superabundant way:--more abundantly, a great deal, far more.

G4055.pos:
1. exceeding some number or measure or rank or need
    1. over and above, more than is necessary, superadded
      1. exceeding abundantly, supremely
      2. something further, more, much more than all, more plainly
    2. superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon
      1. pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
G4055.def: comparative of «4053»; more superabundant (in number, degree or character):--more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

G4056.def: adverb from «4055»; more superabundantly:--more abundant(-ly), × the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather.

G4057.def: adverb from «4053»; superabundantly:--exceedingly, out of measure, the more.

G4058.def: of uncertain derivation; a pigeon:--dove, pigeon.

G4059.def: from «4012» and the base of «5114»; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise:--circumcise.

G4060.def: from «4012» and «5087»; to place around; by implication, to present:--bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

G4061.def: from «4059»; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively):--X circumcised, circumcision.

G4062.def: from «4012» and the base of «5157»; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze:--+ make mad.

G4063.def: from «4012» and «5143» (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse:--run through.

G4064.def: from «4012» and «5342»; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither:--bear (carry) about.

G4065.def: from «4012» and «5426»; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn):--despise.

G4066.def: from «4012» and «5561»; around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with «1093» implied vicinity):--country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about.

G4067.et: from a comparative of (4012) and psao (to rub)
G4067.def: from a comparative of «4012» and psao (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):--offscouring.

G4068.et: middle voice from perperos (braggart, perhaps by reduplication of the base of (4008))
G4068.def: middle voice from perperos (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of «4008»); to boast:--vaunt itself.

G4069.def: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female:--Persis.

G4070.def: adverb from «4009»; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year ago.

G4071.def: neuter of a derivative of «4072»; a flying animal, i.e. bird:--bird, fowl.

G4072.et: middle voice of a primary verb
G4072.def: middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:--fly(-ing).

G4073.def: feminine of the same as «4074»; a (mass of) rock (literally or figuratively):--rock.

G4074.def: apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than «3037»); as a name, Petrus, an apostle:--Peter, rock. Compare «2786».

G4076.def: from «4078»; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves):--rue.

G4077.et: probably from (4078) (through the idea of gushing plumply)
G4077.def: probably from «4078» (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring):--fountain, well.

G4078.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses)
G4078.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent):--pitch.

G4079.et: from a (presumed) derivative of pedon (the blade of an oar, from the same as (3976))
G4079.def: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of pedon (the blade of an oar; from the same as «3976»); a "pedal", i.e. helm:--rudder.

G4080.pos:
1. how great, how large
    1. in a material reference (denoting geometrical magnitude as distinguished from arithmetical)
    2. in an ethical sense: how distinguished
G4080.et: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of (4225)
G4080.def: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of «4225»; how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity:--how great (large).

G4082.def: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:--scrip.

G4083.def: of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit:--cubit.

G4084.def: probably another form of «971»; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)):--apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare «4085».

G4085.def: another form for «4084»; to pack:--press down.

G4086.et: from a compound of a derivative of (3982) and (3056)
G4086.def: from a compound of a derivative of «3982» and «3056»; persuasive language:--enticing words.

G4087.def: from «4089»; to embitter (literally or figuratively):--be (make) bitter.

G4088.def: from «4089»; acridity (especially poison), literally or figuratively:--bitterness.

G4089.et: perhaps from (4078) (through the idea of piercing)
G4089.def: perhaps from «4078» (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent), i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively):--bitter.

G4091.def: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman:--Pilate.

G4092.pos:
1. to blow, to burn
  2. to cause to swell, to render timid
  3. to swell, become swollen
    1. of the parts of the body
G4092.et: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary preo {preh'-o}

G4093.def: diminutive of «4094»; a tablet (for writing on):--writing table.

G4094.def: apparently a form of «4109»; a plate:--charger, platter.

G4095.et: a prolonged form of pio {pee'-o}; which (together with another form poo {po'-o}, occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses
G4095.def: occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or figuratively):--drink.

G4096.et: from pion (fat, perhaps akin to the alternate of (4095) through the idea of repletion)
G4096.def: from pion (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of «4095» through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness):--fatness.

G4097.et: a reduplicated and prolonged form of prao {prah'-o}, (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses), contracted from perao (to traverse, from the base of (4008))
G4097.def: contracted from perao (to traverse; from the base of «4008»); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively):--sell.

G4098.et: a reduplicated and contracted form of peto {pet'-o}, (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses), probably akin to (4072) through the idea of alighting
G4098.def: probably akin to «4072» through the idea of alighting; to fall (literally or figuratively):--fail, fall (down), light on.

G4099.def: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pisidia.
